rule_questions: Does a tier-5 sponsor press release set `year` (and `model_first_use_year`) for a comparison whose status is set by a later tier-1 paper? Rule 6 lists registry posting, online publication, label or print only. Here Idenix's Sep 2008 release reported the fosdevirine 7-day monotherapy result four years before Zala 2012, and the seizure clinical hold was public Feb 2011 vs Castellino Dec 2012; if yes, engagement/dose/efficacy `same` move to 2008 and safety `contra` to 2011, closing the 2009-2012 gap the strip draws.

`model_kind` has no in-vitro value: a cell-culture replication assay with laboratory HIV-1 strains in MT-4/MT4-GFP cells is not ex_vivo (patient cells). Which value should antiviral cell-culture models carry, or should the enum gain `in_vitro`?

When the engagement readout (viral load, proximal) is also the trial's primary endpoint, do engagement and efficacy both score `same` from the same 7-day monotherapy study, or should efficacy wait for a treatment trial with a clinical virologic endpoint (<50 copies/mL at week 48)?
Is a registration by a regulator outside the tier-2 list (elsulfavirine, Russian Ministry of Health, 2017) a tier-2 source, or inadmissible so the member stays without a tier 1-3 patient source?

dor-cyp3a-induction-pk-model joins two in-silico methods under one model_id: nonparametric superposition (Khalilieh 2018, predicts doravirine trough) and a PBPK model (Yee 2021, predicts M9) built later for the same dose adjustment; the 2022 label row tests only the superposition projection, the PBPK's M9 prediction is tested only in the Yee abstract. Decision 8 does not say whether successive in-silico methods for one dosing question are one system or two tracks. [CHECKER_BRIEF_v3 / models]

[CHECKER_BRIEF / fields] Retrodiction for engagement/efficacy counts a patient result on the same target from any drug. Fosdevirine (2008) and doravirine (2012) in-vitro results post-date efavirenz/nevirapine patient results on HIV RT; does a long-established assay (cell-culture replication) re-run for a new member count as a model 'first public after' the class's patient result, making every next-generation NNRTI entry retro?
[CHECKER_BRIEF / fields] Is a second same on one track (efficacy 5, DRIVE-FORWARD after Schurmann monotherapy) an entry with strengthens: true, or a patient_trials item, since it changes no status?

[CHECKER_BRIEF / fields] Retro calls on engagement 2/4 and efficacy 2/4/5 apply the brief's letter (any earlier same-target patient result, member or not; nevirapine/efavirenz for fosdevirine, fosdevirine 2008 for doravirine). If a long-established assay re-run for a new member is meant to stay prospective, these revert to same.
